# DSH Annotation > 在 DSH 选中文字批注并随消息发送，以编号关联回复。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation) - **版本号**：1.4.11（[固定提交 48eac63badf93641f2276b8b0068f6ebbe22ba9b](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation/tree/48eac63badf93641f2276b8b0068f6ebbe22ba9b)） - **版本日期**：2026-11-03（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 静态核查固定提交的批注草稿、提交时序和模型可见性。未执行目标代码或实际宿主验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要逐段追问 DSH 回复的人可收集批注再统一发出。 - **亮点**：[Q01](#research-q01) 将选段和问题统一提交。 - **思考**：[Q03](#research-q03) 隐藏只改气泡显示，模型仍收到内容。 - **建议**：[Q05](#research-q05) 测试显式预览能否减少误发。 采用建议：[Q04](#research-q04) 先测试输入法与合成数据。 ## 核心贡献 [Q01](#research-q01) 将选段和问题统一提交。 ## 关键质疑 [Q03](#research-q03) 隐藏只改气泡显示，模型仍收到内容。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 [Q05](#research-q05) 测试显式预览能否减少误发。 以刷新后带旧草稿情境对照 ## 场景与替代办法 需要逐段追问 DSH 回复的人可收集批注再统一发出。 人工复制和编号有明确可见性，但有重复整理。 ## 依赖与流程 | 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 兼容 Web 宿主 | 必需 | 接入 composer | 改用手工 | | 本地存储 | 跨刷新需要 | 保存草稿 | 只保留当前页面状态 | | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 成功判据或失败处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | 选择 | 标记合成选段 | 核对待发内容 | | 提交 | 检查气泡与回复 | 验证模型输入范围 | | 退出 | 清除草稿、禁用 | 用手工引用 | ## 成本与效果 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次 | 资源未知 | 安装耗时未知 | 需要宿主 | | 持续 | 上下文费用未知 | 校对耗时未知 | 批注增加输入 | | 恢复 | 重试开销未知 | 排查耗时未知 | 存储和输入法有边界 | | 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 | | --- | --- | --- | | 上下文收集 | 有草稿拼接和存储 | 输入法与模型遵循 | ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：批注草稿、提交时序和模型可见性 ### Q01 · 多段批注如何减少手工引用？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 用户可选多段文本记录批注并随问题提交。相比复制后手写编号，扩展负责收集和编号；模型仍需遵循文本指令，是否逐条回答要人工看。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:21-38](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation/blob/48eac63badf93641f2276b8b0068f6ebbe22ba9b/README.md#L21-L38) 作者描述交互与编号
查看原文（18行） ```text Select any text in an assistant reply to annotate it (the annotation body may be left empty = just mark the passage). Annotations accumulate across messages and turns. An **Annotations ×N** chip appears next to the input box — hover to view all annotations, remove them one by one. Press Enter and the annotation block goes to the model together with whatever question is in the input box. **The annotation block never shows up as text in your own message bubble** — only the question plus the chip (content visible on hover; hidden before paint, zero flicker). The model replies with `Annotation 1: …` … `Annotation N: …`, one per annotation, and every Annotation label in the reply is a hoverable chip showing the annotated passage and your note. Form: official **bundle plugin** (`dsh.bundle` + a `dsh.client` declaration in package.json, injected into the browser via client-modules; the Node half is an empty implementation). **Zero core changes** — no DSH files are touched; `cordis.patch.yml` only inserts its own id once, and the profile patch stays `[]`. ## Features Sidebar file annotations (DSH 0.1.6-alpha.1): select plain text, Markdown, or code in a workspace file preview and use the same annotate, save, and Enter-to-send flow. The editor and model-facing quote include the file path. After reloading and reopening the original file, its markers are restored; identical passages in different files remain separate. PDF, images, and HTML inside iframes are not covered. | Feature | Description | |---|---| | Select-to-annotate | Select assistant text → toolbar "Annotate" → write your note (may be empty); dismiss by clicking elsewhere or pressing Esc | | Numbered marker + highlight | A blue numbered marker + highlight anchored to the passage, viewport-anchored with collision avoidance, never lost when scrolled out of view | | Cross-turn collection | Any number of annotations accumulate across messages/turns, numbered from 1 | | "Annotations ×N" chip | Small chip beside the input box; hover shows every annotation, deletable individually | | Enter sends with your message | Annotation block + the question in the input box are sent to the model together (the model receives the full content) | | Hidden in your bubble | The annotation block is removed from your bubble's DOM the moment you send (before the browser paints), leaving only the question + the chip (hover to view); historical messages self-heal after a refresh | | Numbered reply correspondence | A format instruction is injected into the message so the model replies `Annotation 1: …` … `Annotation N: …` one by one | | Reply annotation chips | `Annotation N:` in the reply renders as hoverable chips showing the passage + your note | ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[client.js:1351-1367](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation/blob/48eac63badf93641f2276b8b0068f6ebbe22ba9b/client.js#L1351-L1367) 发送时拼接草稿
查看原文（17行） ```text function onKeyDown(e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') { if (ui.mode !== 'closed') closeToolbar() return } // 【回车随输入框发送】在 composer 里按 Enter（且已收集批注、非输入法合成）： // 提交前一刻把批注块拼进草稿，composer 自己的 Enter 提交继续——模型收到 // 批注清单 + 用户输入的问题。用户始终看不到文本被塞进去。 // IME 铁律（v1.3.10 修了 nativeEvent.keyCode；v1.3.11 补 compositionend // 后 Enter keyCode=13 的时序洞）：合成期 / 上屏确认 Enter 绝不能 setDraft。 // 修饰键守卫（v1.3.18 修 issue #10）：Shift+Enter 换行、Alt+Enter 默认路径 // 不触发拼稿；裸 Enter 继续处理带文字草稿，Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 只接管空草稿 // 的纯批注。已有文字时交回 composer，保留宿主的 Queue / Steer 策略。 // 纯批注的 Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 需要在这里直接提交：composer 的 accelerated 路径在 // 「运行中 + 有排队消息」时会走 steerQueue，而不是发送当前草稿；我们在 // capture 阶段 setDraft 后 stopPropagation，主动 submit('queue')，保证 // 纯批注能直接发出，同时不会把批注块明文留在输入框。 ```
#### 缺口 - 未看实际编号响应 **影响**：不能保证模型遵循 **进一步探讨**：用三段引用检查回复对应 ### Q02 · 怎样与宿主发送顺序协调？ **研究主题**：功能与机制、工程质量与复用 #### 完整回答 捕获阶段监听 Enter，限制修饰键与输入位置，避开输入法提交。普通附加后交给宿主发送，特定加速手势走 scope 和 submit queue。依赖 DOM 锚点和宿主上下文，标记改变会破坏接线。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[client.js:1368-1408](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation/blob/48eac63badf93641f2276b8b0068f6ebbe22ba9b/client.js#L1368-L1408) 输入法、双 DOM 分支、显式提交
查看原文（41行） ```text if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.shiftKey && !e.altKey && ui.quotes.length > 0) { // 双分支门控：DSH ≥0.1.2 是 div[data-composer-input] 输入区，≤0.1.1 是 textarea。 // 1.4.6 适配 0.1.2 时移除了 textarea 分支，旧核心上 Enter 因此不再拼入批注块 // （只剩发送按钮路径可用）。两条分支并行保留。 var input = e.target instanceof Element && (e.target.closest('[data-composer-input]') || (e.target instanceof HTMLTextAreaElement && e.target.closest('[data-composer-card]'))) if (input && input.closest('[data-composer-card]') !== null) { if (isImeKeyBlocked(e)) { // 宿主的合成尾窗可能短于这里的 50ms。仅在本来会拼批注的 // 手势上拦住宿主提交；不 preventDefault，保留输入法确认行为。 if (shouldGuardImeEnter(e)) e.stopPropagation() return } var attached = attachAndSend(e) if (attached && (e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey)) { e.preventDefault() e.stopPropagation() submitAttached() } } } } // capture 阶段：必须先于 composer 自己的 Enter 处理（React 在容器层冒泡 // 提交）——否则等我们执行时消息已提交，拼稿永远太迟。 document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown, true) function submitAttached() { var current = readCurrentSessionId() if (current === undefined) { console.warn('[annotation] 无法确定当前会话，批注直接提交已跳过') return } var scoped = sessions.scope(current) if (scoped === undefined) { console.warn('[annotation] 当前会话 scope 不可用，批注直接提交已跳过') return } try { ctx.conversation.input.for(scoped).submit('queue') ```
#### 缺口 - 未验证各种输入法 **影响**：可能出现误触或遗漏 **进一步探讨**：检查中文合成、队列和提交按钮 ### Q03 · 气泡不显示是否代表内容未发送？ **研究主题**：缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 批注块被拼入草稿发给模型，气泡装饰只影响展示。待发批注也按会话键存入 localStorage，存储失败会降级。不能因为气泡只显示原提问就认为选段没进入宿主消息。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[README.md:31-38](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation/blob/48eac63badf93641f2276b8b0068f6ebbe22ba9b/README.md#L31-L38) 作者说明展示与模型差异 ```text | Select-to-annotate | Select assistant text → toolbar "Annotate" → write your note (may be empty); dismiss by clicking elsewhere or pressing Esc | | Numbered marker + highlight | A blue numbered marker + highlight anchored to the passage, viewport-anchored with collision avoidance, never lost when scrolled out of view | | Cross-turn collection | Any number of annotations accumulate across messages/turns, numbered from 1 | | "Annotations ×N" chip | Small chip beside the input box; hover shows every annotation, deletable individually | | Enter sends with your message | Annotation block + the question in the input box are sent to the model together (the model receives the full content) | | Hidden in your bubble | The annotation block is removed from your bubble's DOM the moment you send (before the browser paints), leaving only the question + the chip (hover to view); historical messages self-heal after a refresh | | Numbered reply correspondence | A format instruction is injected into the message so the model replies `Annotation 1: …` … `Annotation N: …` one by one | | Reply annotation chips | `Annotation N:` in the reply renders as hoverable chips showing the passage + your note | ``` **依据 2 · 源码核查**：[client.js:1084-1102](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-annotation/blob/48eac63badf93641f2276b8b0068f6ebbe22ba9b/client.js#L1084-L1102) 浏览器草稿存储
查看原文（19行） ```text function readPendingQuotes(sessionId) { if (sessionId === undefined) return [] try { return parsePendingQuotes(localStorage.getItem(pendingStorageKey(sessionId))) } catch (err) { console.warn('[annotation] 读取待发送批注失败：', err) return [] } } function writePendingQuotes(sessionId) { if (sessionId === undefined) return try { var key = pendingStorageKey(sessionId) if (ui.quotes.length === 0) localStorage.removeItem(key) else localStorage.setItem(key, stringifyPendingQuotes(ui.quotes)) } catch (err) { console.warn('[annotation] 保存待发送批注失败：', err) } ```
